checks.finding: The exact final01 manifest and all 47 declared members match byte counts and SHA-256; the complete read set is unchanged at the final bookend. Ancillary wrapper documents are not misrepresented as manifest members.

generation_inputs requires the actual r10-r1-operator-r8 runtime32 manifest, actual combination and export pins, consumer PACKAGE_SHA/CURRENT_POLICY_SHA/CURRENT_POLICY_ADOPTION_SHA, and readiness BOUNDARY_CONSUMER_SHA256. Actual adoption v1, decision v1, linked originals, boot, 44 unique permission atoms and explicit nonautomatic decision fields are checked. Independent adoption verification remains a prior obligation; these source relationships do not award adoption.

The actual fault package must have the original eight members. Seven non-active members match immutable reference descriptors exactly. The active source must reverse byte-for-byte to the original after replacing only CONSUMER_SHA, READINESS_SHA, POLICY_SHA and ADOPTION_SHA; each actual value is checked.

derive fills one FINAL_DEPENDENCIES RHS in each of exactly common, watch, phone capture and P4 capture. Each template starts None and is checked by a whole-byte inverse. Watch and phone projections match their consumers; the phone verifier pin binds the unchanged independent closer, and P4 binds the original sender.

Freezing requires a fresh canonical direct-child namespace, preserves candidate and input originals, writes created inodes with fsync and identity bookends, rechecks input originals, and keeps the 32 MiB/128-member bounds. It invokes no phone, task, registration, model or fault actor entry.

Preparation derives the nonce from the retained v150.3 task template, verifies the unchanged UTF-8 request hash and single nonce occurrence, matches previous session/profile, and validates the original template/app scope against the fixed configuration. No replacement nonce or owner text is generated.

The actual READY bytes produce the runtime binding and four original role identities. The immutable active-runtime validators enforce the six release pins, adopted export, boot and transport-only READY semantics. NEG-04 has no probe/helper; NEG-05/07 require an original registered probe, canonicalized only for comparison, and the original shell/busybox pins as appropriate. Only NEG-04, NEG-05 and NEG-07 are admitted.

S.admit checks actual dependencies again, fixed original sender bytes/path, exact previous identity and terminal, nonempty preserved draft, retirement original, successful unconsumed registration readback, configuration/service pins, and watch/runtime/task expectations before emitting an execution plan.

Preparation retains its inputs and watch/root plans in a new label namespace. It precompiles exact stage/watch recipes under the existing <65536-byte ADB and 131072-byte P4 packet bounds, then returns one argv with exact manifest and plan hashes. That argv matches the Root --execute-once parser. Preparation calls no sender, phone actor, subprocess or remote execution entry.

Freeze and prepare results explicitly report zero phone/Send/signal activity and false physical/whole-case qualification. A real independent adoption, final sealed runtime, original READY, registration and subsequent one-time physical execution are still required. The existing author 24+6 checks were read for scope and were not rerun or counted as physical evidence.

scope: Two frozen source entry interfaces and their directly referenced pure admission contracts; not a full business audit or an actual source freeze/prepare result.
